description: Pins stay pins: actions by commit hash with the version in a comment, images by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker. The repository requires SHA-pinned actions, and tests/static/50-workflow-policy.sh fails a change that turns one back into a tag.

Digest, pin, patch and minor updates of actions and images merge on their own, as a squash, when every check of the pull request is green. Renovate reads the checks itself: platformAutomerge is off, because main has no required checks and GitHub's own auto-merge would merge a red pull request. A major update and a keyring image wait for a person.
The verify image of the targets and the Arch image of the tests move in one pull request. So CI runs pacman in the image that the targets will verify with, before that image merges.
ignorePaths replaces the preset's list, which ignores **/tests/**: the test images are pins too.
tests/static/75-renovate.sh fails an image pin that the regex manager below does not match, and an automerge rule for major updates.

packageRules.description: Actions move weekly in one pull request, and only to a release at least three days old, so a release that is pulled or hijacked upstream has time to be noticed before it lands here.
Small updates of actions and images merge when CI is green.
The 15 verify_image lines and the tests' Arch image: one pull request.

The keyring images of the targets (keyring_image): one pull request, which a person merges. Their keyrings are the trust root of the aarch64, armv7h, loong64 and riscv64 targets, and no CI job runs them.
The node image of worker.yml and ci.yml: one pull request, so the Worker is tested in the image that deploys it.

customManagers.description: An image pinned by digest under a '# tag: <tag>' marker: the verify and keyring images of each target, and the images the workflows, the scripts and the tests run.
